Do not assume every broken image or empty main section is an animation.", "external_embeds": "An unavailable third-party video, social widget or auxiliary embed alone is not a material defect when the surrounding page still communicates its information and supports its purpose. Assess its contextual role: missing sole essential instructions or content is different from an optional supplementary player. Do not infer source content missing merely because reference coverage is shorter.", "material_defects": "Require observable impact on core information, understanding or essential visible controls: a blank/blocked main interface, materially incoherent text, substantial unreadability or overlap, repeated broken editorial/product imagery, or an essential control whose label/purpose is not understandable. Existing accessibility-tool violations alone do not imply failure.", "evidence_coherence": "Assess whether the supplied states belong to the intended reference/target comparison under its category and form a coherent assessable set. A blurred or empty label on such a button is a material control defect even if other navigation is available. This does not apply to excluded advertisements or auxiliary external widgets. Distinguish the button itself from decorative animation around it.", "structural_context": "The supplied DOM component inventory identifies animation players, carousels, embedded media and fixed/sticky elements in the saved HTML. Use this factual context with the screenshots to interpret temporal differences; an intermediate empty frame of a documented animation is not missing semantic information by itself. DOM presence does not prove successful rendering or interaction, and does not excuse broken static editorial images.
